description: This file defines low-level, thread-safe logging routines for the Abseil C++ library, including macros for raw logging and internal logging mechanisms, as well as function declarations for logging support in signal-safe contexts.

methods.name: RawLog
methods.description: Logs formatted messages at a specified severity level, reporting the source file and line number, without memory allocation or locking.

methods.name: AsyncSignalSafeWriteToStderr
methods.description: Writes a buffer directly to stderr in a signal-safe, low-level manner.

methods.name: Basename
methods.description: Compile-time function to extract the base filename from a path.

methods.name: RawLoggingFullySupported
methods.description: Checks if raw logging is fully supported on the current platform.

methods.name: RegisterLogFilterAndPrefixHook
methods.description: Registers a hook for customizing log message filtering and prefixing.

methods.name: RegisterAbortHook
methods.description: Registers a hook to handle aborting on fatal logs.

methods.name: RegisterInternalLogFunction
methods.description: Registers a custom internal log function.
